# NEXUS

> NEXUS is the trust and compliance engine for India's craft economy: a status-aware
> Merchant of Record that lets verified artisans sell handicraft, textiles, jewellery,
> gems, naturals and craft experiences worldwide — with documented provenance, fair pay
> (makers keep ~81%, settled in ~2 days), and full GST/export compliance carried by NEXUS.
> AI-operated with a human-in-the-loop founder. Bilingual (English/Hindi).

## What NEXUS is
- A Merchant of Record for India's craft economy — artisans need no GST or company.
- Covers every vertical: handicraft, textiles, jewellery, gems, naturals, experiences/tourism.
- Provenance-first: GI tags, hallmarks and lab certificates verify authenticity.

## For each audience
- Artisans: sell globally, keep ~81%, paid to their own bank, no GST/company needed.
- Buyers: authentic, provenance-tagged craft with buyer protection; meet the maker; visit where it's made.
- Institutions (cooperatives, shops, NGOs, government): onboard and formalise artisans, source verified craft, deliver schemes to verified beneficiaries.

## Key facts
- Platform fee ~12%; never-in-loss guarantee; zero float (payments split at the gateway).
- Connects artisans to government schemes: PM Vishwakarma, MUDRA, e-Shram, ODOP, GeM, ONDC, GI, Udyam, SFURTI, export incentives.
- Sources makers from public GI registry, data.gov.in, ODOP and myScheme; every maker is consent-gated before selling.

## Authenticity & trust
- Every listing carries registry-verified provenance; high-value items require certificates.
- No fabricated products, reviews or photos; honest-stage and consent-before-sale are hard invariants.
